title: Each row of the / command list wears its own icon
goal: Typing / in Ask lists the commands you can run, and today every row in an area shows that area's one icon, where the mock gives each command its own. Give each row its own icon so the list can be read at a glance.
notes: Left by typing-in-ask-lists-the-commands-you-can-run. Mock: askPalHTML in docs/design/mocks/shared/dist/photonz-ds.js. New Conversation has to decide what Ask forgets: its memory of what it made comes from the rows (AskSession.conversation).
acceptance: Each row of the / list shows an icon for that command, as agent-generate-wt.html does, not one shared by its whole area
